title: These were the 10 best-performing S&P 500 stocks in 2024
summary: The S&P 500 had a strong year in 2024, surging about 23% to record highs, marking the first time the index posted back-to-back annual returns of over 20% since the late 1990s. While the overall market performed well, several S&P 500 companies significantly outperformed, with gains more than quintupling the index's return. This article lists the top 10 best-performing S&P 500 stocks of 2024, showcasing companies like Palantir, Vistra, and Nvidia, which saw gains exceeding 170%.

title: Management That Matters: 2024’s Best U.S. Companies Unveiled
summary: The 2024 Drucker Institute Company Rankings identify the 30 best-managed U.S. companies based on corporate effectiveness across five categories: customer satisfaction, financial strength, social responsibility, innovation, and employee engagement. Apple secured the top spot as the best-managed company with an effectiveness score of 92.1, surpassing Microsoft from its 2023 position. Nvidia and Microsoft followed, with Intel and MasterCard rounding out the top five, demonstrating the importance of innovation and financial strength for high effectiveness scores.

title: Hyperscale data CEO William Horne sells shares for $10
summary: William B. Horne, CEO of Hyperscale Data, Inc. (NASDAQ: GPUS), recently sold 2 shares of company stock for a total of $10, leaving him with no direct holdings. This transaction occurs as the stock trades near its 52-week low and analysis suggests it is undervalued despite a weak financial health score. The company is actively pursuing financial strategies including expanding equity, managing debt, and planning a significant expansion of its AI data center.

title: Sustainable and Successful: 3 Climate ETFs Beating the Market
summary: This article highlights three climate-focused ETFs—iShares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF (USCL), Xtrackers MSCI USA Climate Action Equity ETF (USCA), and SPDR MSCI USA Climate Paris Aligned ETF (NZUS)—that have outperformed the S&P 500. These ETFs offer investors ways to support companies mitigating climate change while also achieving strong financial returns. The article details each ETF's approach to sustainable investing, their expense ratios, asset bases, and recent performance.

title: iShares Global Equity Factor ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the iShares Global Equity Factor ETF (GLOF), which was established in 2015 and focuses on total market equity. The ETF manages $203.3 million in assets across 651 holdings, selecting and weighting stocks based on quality, value, momentum, smaller size, and low volatility factors. The holdings list includes major companies like NVIDIA, Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft, along with numerous other global stocks and various currency cash positions.

title: U.S. Global Investors launches defense-focused WAR ETF - ICYMI
summary: U.S. Global Investors (NASDAQ:GROW) has launched a new defense-focused ETF named WAR, listed on the New York Stock Exchange. CEO Frank Holmes explained that the ETF invests in companies related to defense and cybersecurity, driven by surging global military spending which reached $2.40 trillion in 2023. The ETF utilizes a Smart Beta 2.0 strategy, incorporating industries like aerospace, semiconductors, and data centers to provide a diversified exposure to the national defense sector.

title: Schwab Trading Activity Index™: December Score Edges Higher for Third Consecutive Month
summary: The Schwab Trading Activity Index™ (STAX) increased to 51.16 in December, marking its third consecutive monthly rise. Schwab clients net bought equities, adding exposure in Health Care and Energy sectors, while selling Information Technology and Communication Services. The report highlights market volatility, key economic data releases, and popular stocks bought and sold by Schwab clients throughout December and the entirety of 2024.

title: HP Inc. Unleashes New AI PCs At CES 2025, Wins Three Innovation Awards
summary: HP Inc. unveiled a new lineup of AI-powered PCs at CES 2025, winning three innovation awards for devices like the Omnibook Ultra Flip and its embedded AI Companion. The company is targeting various user types, from entry-level workers to on-the-go executives, with new models such as the OmniStudio X Series, EliteBook Ultra, and EliteBook X, all featuring enhanced NPUs and AI capabilities. HP emphasizes its commitment to providing tools that boost productivity, creativity, and connectivity for every user.

title: CES 2025: HP’s OMEN AI Casts a Spell on Gaming, Optimizing Performance with a Single Click
summary: HP announced new OMEN and HyperX gaming products at CES 2025, including the OMEN AI, the world's first AI-driven 1-click performance optimization tool. The OMEN MAX 16 is introduced as HP's most powerful gaming laptop, featuring NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and enhanced thermal management. Additionally, HP unveiled the OMEN 32x Smart Gaming Monitor with built-in Google TV and the customizable HyperX Pulsefire Saga mice series.

title: CES 2025: Shaping the Future of Play
summary: Josephine Tan, Senior Vice President & General Manager, Gaming Personal Systems at HP, details new gaming innovations unveiled at CES 2025. The article highlights new OMEN laptops and desktops, enhanced Victus laptops, new OMEN monitors with high refresh rates, and precise HyperX mice. These products are designed to offer immersive, high-performance, and personalized gaming experiences, supported by HP's ongoing strategic alliance with Riot Games.

title: Marvell Announces Breakthrough Co-Packaged Optics Architecture for Custom AI Accelerators
summary: Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) announced a new co-packaged optics (CPO) architecture for its custom XPU AI accelerators. This innovation enables higher bandwidth and longer reach scale-up fabric connections, enhancing AI server performance by allowing hundreds of XPUs across multiple racks, compared to tens within a single rack using traditional copper interconnects. The architecture integrates optical components directly into the XPU package, reducing signal loss, improving power efficiency, and supporting up to 100X longer connections with optimal latency.

title: NVIDIA Puts Grace Blackwell on Every Desk and at Every AI Developer’s Fingertips
summary: NVIDIA has introduced Project DIGITS, a personal AI supercomputer powered by the new GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, designed to bring powerful AI computing capabilities to researchers, data scientists, and students. This desktop system offers a petaflop of AI performance for developing and running large AI models, which can then be seamlessly deployed to cloud or data center infrastructures. With a starting price of $3,000, Project DIGITS aims to democratize access to advanced AI development tools, fostering innovation in the field.

title: NVIDIA Launches AI Foundation Models for RTX AI PCs
summary: NVIDIA announced the launch of foundation models for RTX AI PCs, designed to power digital humans, content creation, productivity, and development. These models, offered as NVIDIA NIM microservices, are accelerated by new GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, featuring significant AI performance and supporting FP4 compute for enhanced inference. NVIDIA is collaborating with top PC manufacturers to integrate these NIM-ready RTX AI PCs, emphasizing the company's commitment to advancing AI accessibility for developers and enthusiasts.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 Series Opens New World of AI Computer Graphics
summary: NVIDIA has announced its new GeForce RTX 50 Series Desktop and Laptop GPUs, powered by the Blackwell architecture, which aim to revolutionize AI computer graphics. These GPUs offer significant performance increases, up to 2x over the previous generation, through advancements in neural shaders, DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, and AI-driven rendering. The new series also introduces AI-powered tools for creators, autonomous game characters, and strengthens AI capabilities for PCs.

title: CES 2025: AI Advancing at ‘Incredible Pace,’ NVIDIA CEO Says
summary: At CES 2025, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang announced several innovations, emphasizing the shift towards "physical AI" that can perceive, reason, plan, and act. Key reveals included the NVIDIA Cosmos platform for physical AI, new Blackwell-based GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, and AI tools for RTX PCs. Huang highlighted partnerships with companies like Toyota and Uber, and introduced Project DIGITS, NVIDIA's smallest yet most powerful AI supercomputer, underscoring AI's rapid advancement across gaming, robotics, and autonomous vehicles.

title: NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion Platform Achieves Critical Automotive Safety and Cybersecurity Milestones for AV Development
summary: The NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion autonomous vehicle platform has achieved critical automotive safety and cybersecurity milestones, receiving certifications from TÜV SÜD and TÜV Rheinland. This platform, adopted by automotive manufacturers like Mercedes-Benz and JLR, will feature the high-performance DRIVE AGX Thor SoC built on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture. NVIDIA has also established an AI Systems Inspection Lab to help partners meet evolving safety and AI standards for autonomous driving software.

title: Soluna Signs Deal with Atlas Cloud to Deliver Sustainable AI Video Processing
summary: Soluna Holdings, Inc. announced a deal with Atlas Cloud to provide sustainable AI video processing services, utilizing 64 Nvidia H100 GPUs with potential for expansion. This partnership, secured through Soluna's collaboration with HPE GreenLake, marks Soluna's second AI customer and highlights its commitment to delivering renewable-powered cloud services for intensive computing applications. The agreement reinforces Atlas Cloud's mission to offer a sustainable, one-stop AI cloud platform for various industry verticals.

title: Nvidia's keynote at CES a positive catalyst for Super Micro Computer - Analyst
summary: Lynx Equity has reiterated a $60 price target for Super Micro Computer (SMCI), viewing Nvidia's CES keynote as a positive catalyst. The firm believes Super Micro's lead in liquid-cooled technology positions it well for the demands of Nvidia's next-gen GB300 platform and other AI server needs. Although considered speculative, the company's potential for a debt-financed capital raise could benefit inventory and AI server expansion.

title: Intel Extends Leadership in AI PCs and Edge Computing at CES 2025
summary: At CES 2025, Intel unveiled new Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processors, including the 200V series with Intel vPro for businesses, and 200HX and H series for creators and gamers, all featuring cutting-edge AI enhancements and performance improvements. Intel also introduced a new suite of processors for edge computing, showcasing significant performance gains in AI workloads compared to previous generations and competitors. The availability of these new systems is set to begin in January and February 2025, with further releases planned for the first half of the year.

title: SK Group to Showcase 'Innovative AI, Sustainable Tomorrow' at CES 2025
summary: SK Group announced its participation in CES 2025 with an exhibition themed "Innovative AI, Sustainable Tomorrow," aiming to showcase its advanced AI technologies and services. Chairman Chey Tae-won will attend for the third consecutive year to strengthen global AI partnerships. The exhibition will feature AI data centers, AI services, and an AI ecosystem, jointly operated by four SK affiliates, to demonstrate their vision for AI business.

title: Arbe Robotics jumps on Nvidia collaboration
summary: Arbe Robotics (Nasdaq: ARBE; TASE: ARBE) saw its stock jump 64% after announcing a collaboration with Nvidia. The Israeli auto-tech chip company will integrate its high-resolution radar with Nvidia DRIVE AGX to enhance free space mapping and AI-driven capabilities for advanced automotive safety and autonomous driving. This partnership will be showcased at CES 2025, and the stock surge has pushed Arbe's share price above a critical $3.1 threshold required for a convertible bond transfer.

title: Best and worst performing ETFs of 2024
summary: The article reviews the best and worst-performing ETFs of 2024, highlighting that trends from the previous year, particularly the strong performance of tech and blockchain ETFs, largely continued. Tech ETFs benefited from outperforming earnings and the rise of AI, while blockchain ETFs were boosted by interest rate cuts, spot bitcoin ETF approvals, and crypto advocacy. Conversely, clean energy and Brazil ETFs were among the worst performers, with the former continuing a slump and the latter impacted by fiscal concerns and currency depreciation.

title: This Chinese AI Stock Is Preparing for ‘Explosive Growth’ in 2025. Is It Too Late to Buy?
summary: Baidu, often referred to as the "Google of China," is rapidly transforming into an AI powerhouse, with its ERNIE Bot and Apollo autonomous driving platform gaining significant traction. Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment impacting its online marketing revenue, Baidu is heavily investing in AI, reporting strong growth in AI Cloud revenue and high user engagement with its generative AI content. Analysts project substantial sales and earnings growth, with the stock currently valued at an attractive multiple, suggesting significant upside potential.

title: Ceva Expands Embedded AI NPU Ecosystem with New Partnerships That Accelerate Time-to-Market for Smart Edge Devices
summary: Ceva, Inc. announced new partnerships with Cyberon Corporation and AIZIP, expanding its embedded AI ecosystem for the Ceva-NeuPro-Nano NPU. These collaborations aim to accelerate time-to-market for smart edge devices by offering pre-optimized AI models for tasks like keyword spotting and face recognition. Additionally, Ceva's partnership with Edge Impulse now includes full integration of Edge Impulse Studio and support for NVIDIA's TAO Toolkit, further simplifying and speeding up AI application development and deployment.

title: UniFirst Shares Skyrocket As Cintas Reveals $275 Per Share Acquisition Offer
summary: Cintas Corporation has made a public offer to acquire UniFirst Corporation for $275 per share in cash, valuing UniFirst at approximately $5.3 billion. This offer represents a significant premium to UniFirst's recent closing prices. Despite Cintas emphasizing the strategic fit and operational synergies, UniFirst's board has repeatedly declined to engage in discussions, prompting Cintas to publicize its proposal to UniFirst shareholders.

title: Markets News, January 7, 2025: Stocks Slide as Treasury Yields Rise After Economic Data; Nvidia Leads Tech Selloff; Bitcoin Plunges
summary: Stocks closed sharply lower on January 7, 2025, with major indexes like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite falling, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average also slipped. This downturn was driven by rising Treasury yields following stronger-than-expected economic data, particularly in the labor market, which suggested the Federal Reserve might not cut interest rates as quickly as anticipated. Nvidia led a broader tech selloff despite initial gains from its CEO's CES keynote, and Bitcoin plunged below $100,000, reflecting decreased appetite for risk-on assets in a higher interest rate environment.

title: Astera Labs to triple the size of its Silicon Valley headquarters
summary: Astera Labs, an AI firm, is set to triple the size of its Silicon Valley headquarters by leasing a 154,200 square-foot office complex in north San Jose. The move, expected in spring, allows the company to relocate from its current 51,300 square-foot Santa Clara office and accommodate its rapid growth following a significant IPO in March 2024. This expansion highlights the continued strength of the technology sector in driving large office leases in Silicon Valley.

title: AMD invests $20M in AI-powered drug discovery company Absci
summary: AMD has invested $20 million in Absci Corp., an AI-powered company focused on drug discovery, and will also partner with them on research. Absci, which uses artificial intelligence to identify therapeutic proteins and epitopes, will shift some of its workloads to AMD's Instinct AI processors and utilize AMD's ROCm software. This collaboration aims to enhance Absci's AI models and develop new hardware and software optimized for the healthcare sector, particularly in drug discovery.

title: Arizona will host third CHIPS R&D flagship facility
summary: Arizona State University Research Park in Tempe has been selected as the site for the third CHIPS for America research and development facility, focusing on semiconductor prototyping and packaging. This facility, which will be operational by Q4 2028, will involve the highest financial investment among the three R&D centers. It aims to bridge lab-to-production challenges by providing a manufacturing-like setting for diverse R&D activities, leveraging Arizona's existing microelectronics ecosystem.

title: Where to find the best value opportunities at start of 2025
summary: As 2025 begins, investors are questioning whether to seek value beyond robust US equities. Experts suggest diversifying into areas like gilts, Asian equities, UK smaller companies, and even undervalued US smaller companies and Chinese markets, emphasizing active management and broad diversification. The article highlights specific funds and trusts for these opportunities.

title: Nvidia CEO has sent quantum computing stocks tumbling
summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's prediction that practical quantum computing is still 20 years away has caused a significant drop in the stock prices of several quantum computing companies, with some falling nearly 50%. Despite the setbacks and skepticism, Huang also highlighted NVIDIA's crucial role in the nascent quantum industry, as classical computers, particularly powerful GPUs, are essential for error correction and simulation in quantum development. D-Wave's CEO, Dr. Alan Baratz, however, disputes Huang's assessment, claiming D-Wave's approach is years ahead and sees collaboration potential with NVIDIA for quantum processing units (QPUs) and GPUs.

title: This AI ETF Has Favorable 2025 Setup
summary: The WisdomTree Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Fund (WTAI) is poised for a favorable 2025 setup due to projected elevated AI spending, building on its impressive 2024 performance. While benefiting from its significant allocation to semiconductor stocks, the ETF's diverse holdings, including software and cloud computing names, position it to capture broader AI-driven growth. Experts suggest a shift from hardware to software benefits as generative AI matures, aligning with WTAI's diversified strategy.

title: Delta (DAL), AMD, Walgreens (WBA) ou Constellation Energy (CEG): qual ação comprar e qual pular
summary: This article analyzes four major companies—Delta Air Lines (DAL), AMD, Walgreens (WBA), and Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG)—to guide investors on which stocks to buy and which to avoid. It recommends buying Delta and Constellation Energy due to strong financial performance and stable market positions, while advising to skip Walgreens and AMD due to ongoing restructuring challenges and competitive pressures, respectively. The analysis emphasizes considering financial health, growth potential, and individual risk tolerance before making investment decisions.

title: NVIDIA Announces Blueprint for AI Retail Shopping Assistants
summary: NVIDIA has introduced the NVIDIA AI Blueprint for retail shopping assistants, a generative AI workflow aimed at enhancing online and in-store shopping experiences. This blueprint, built on NVIDIA AI Enterprise and Omniverse platforms, empowers developers to create AI-powered digital assistants capable of tasks like understanding text/image prompts, searching multiple items, and presenting products in virtual environments. The initiative seeks to improve customer satisfaction, boost conversion rates, and reduce returns by providing personalized and intelligent shopping assistance.

title: Rigetti Computing: An Egregiously Overvalued Quantum Computing Stock
summary: The article argues that Rigetti Computing (RGTI), despite being a pioneer in quantum computing, is egregiously overvalued, with a price-to-sales ratio around 250 at the time of analysis. The author highlights the speculative nature of its stock, contrasting it with companies like Nvidia which have much lower P/S ratios despite high growth rates. While bullish on the quantum computing industry's long-term potential, the author advises against investing in Rigetti due to its current valuation, suggesting a P/S multiple of no more than 100 would be justifiable, preferably 50 or less.

title: 주가 떨어지면 매수…고수들, 아이온큐·엔비디아 사모았다
summary: 국내 투자수익률 상위 1%의 초고수들이 최근 주가가 급락한 양자 컴퓨터 기업 아이온큐와 엔비디아 주식을 집중 매수했다. 이는 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO의 양자 컴퓨터 개발 전망 발언과 CES 기조연설 이후 주가 하락을 저가 매수 기회로 판단한 것으로 보인다. 반면 테슬라와 인튜이티브 머신스, 사운드하운드AI 등은 차익 실현 또는 주가 고평가 우려로 순매도 상위에 올랐다.

title: Fundsmith Equity Underperforms for the Fourth Year | Morningstar UK
summary: Fundsmith Equity, the UK's largest fund, underperformed global markets for the fourth consecutive year in 2024, despite an 8.9% growth rate compared to the MSCI World Index's 20.8%. Fund manager Terry Smith attributed this to extreme market concentration in a few tech stocks and made several portfolio changes, including selling Diageo, McCormick, and Apple, and buying Atlas Copco and Texas Instruments. The article also discusses Smith's views on passive funds' role in AI growth and notes that despite recent underperformance, Fundsmith Equity still boasts strong long-term returns since its inception.

title: 3 Stocks To Consider Buying For 'UPtober'
summary: The article discusses three stocks, Nvidia, Amphenol Corporation, and Bank of America, that are historically strong performers in October and November ("UPtober"). It highlights their seasonal patterns, recent performance, and target prices, offering trading strategies for each. The author emphasizes the reliability of these patterns, especially outside of the 2018 outlier year.

title: IQVIA and NVIDIA Collaborate to Transform Healthcare and Life Sciences Through Advanced Agentic AI Solutions
summary: IQVIA and NVIDIA have announced a strategic collaboration to advance AI solutions in healthcare and life sciences, leveraging IQVIA’s data and expertise with NVIDIA’s AI Foundry service. This partnership aims to accelerate IQVIA Healthcare-grade AI™ by developing agentic AI solutions to automate complex workflows and improve patient outcomes. Initial solutions are expected to reach the market within the calendar year, utilizing NVIDIA's advanced AI technologies and platforms.

title: NVIDIA Statement on the Biden Administration’s Misguided ‘AI Diffusion’ Rule
summary: NVIDIA expresses strong disapproval of the Biden Administration's new "AI Diffusion" rule, arguing it will stifle innovation and economic growth by restricting mainstream computing applications. The company contends that this overreach undermines America's technological leadership and global competitiveness, advocating for policies that promote innovation and open competition instead.

title: Markets Brief: Why Good News Can Be Bad News for Stock Investors
summary: US stock prices fell following stronger-than-expected employment numbers, highlighting investor concerns that positive economic news could lead to stickier inflation and fewer interest rate cuts in 2025. This downturn, particularly affecting high-growth technology companies whose valuations are sensitive to discount rates, suggests that value stocks may be better positioned. Upcoming inflation data and Taiwan Semiconductor earnings are expected to influence market volatility.

title: DLO Stock: Price, Forecast, Financials & AI Analysis
summary: This article provides an analysis of DLocal Ltd. (DLO) stock, including its price, forecast, and financials as of May 2026. It highlights the company's Q1 2026 earnings, which showed significant revenue and total payment volume growth, but also noted a decline in net profit due to tax adjustments and increased operating expenses. Analyst ratings express a "Moderate Buy" consensus, with revised price targets reflecting slightly reduced optimism due to rising expenses despite strong volume growth.

title: AI Enables Major Healthcare Advances At JP Morgan Event
summary: The JP Morgan Healthcare Conference is increasingly focusing on AI's transformative role in medicine. Nvidia is a key player, powering digital healthcare devices and collaborating with institutions like Mayo Clinic and IQVIA to drive AI-driven diagnostics and genomic insights. The article posits that AI will revolutionize healthcare, particularly in eradicating diseases like cancer, by leveraging vast clinical data to develop personalized medicine.

title: Illumina and NVIDIA collaborate to decode biology and propel precision health
summary: Illumina and NVIDIA are partnering to advance technology platforms for multiomic data analysis and interpretation. This collaboration aims to accelerate drug discovery and clinical development by combining Illumina's sequencing technologies and software with NVIDIA's AI tools, including foundation models and accelerated computing. The initial phase will focus on enabling Illumina's DRAGEN algorithms on NVIDIA GPUs and integrating NVIDIA's image processing tools into Illumina's Connected Software.

title: VIDEO: ETF of the Week: FBCG
summary: VettaFi's Head of Research, Todd Rosenbluth, discusses the Fidelity Blue Chip Growth ETF (FBCG) with Chuck Jaffe, highlighting its strong performance in 2023 and 2024. FBCG is presented as an actively managed, large-cap growth strategy with a proven track record, offering the efficiency and liquidity of an ETF. The discussion also touches upon "blue chip" as a definition of quality growth companies and the considerations for investors transitioning from the mutual fund version.

title: IQVIA Partners with NVIDIA to Transform Healthcare AI, Accelerate Drug Development
summary: IQVIA has announced a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to advance healthcare and life sciences using AI. This collaboration will leverage IQVIA’s healthcare intelligence and NVIDIA’s AI technologies to develop agentic AI solutions, aiming to accelerate drug development and improve patient outcomes. Initial solutions are expected to be deployed within the calendar year, focusing on automating complex workflows and creating new efficiencies across the therapeutic life cycle.

title: Supermicro Empowers AI-driven Capabilities for Enterprise, Retail, and Edge Server Solutions
summary: Supermicro is showcasing its latest AI server, storage, and edge computing solutions for the retail industry at the National Retail Federation (NRF) annual show, in collaboration with NVIDIA. These solutions aim to enhance retail operations, security, and efficiency by leveraging generative AI for personalized shopping, logistical automation, and shrinkage prevention. Supermicro highlights its broad portfolio of edge AI solutions and various server systems designed to deliver high-end performance at retail locations, demonstrating use cases like digital human customer service, AI shopping assistants, and video search for loss prevention.

title: Although Quantum is ‘Decades’ Away For NVIDIA, The Company is Investing in Quantum Talent Today
summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang believes practical quantum computing is still 15-30 years away, but the company is actively investing in quantum technologies and workforce development. Through strategic hires in areas like quantum error correction and algorithm engineering, NVIDIA is preparing for a hybrid quantum-classical future where quantum accelerators complement classical supercomputers. This proactive investment aims to position NVIDIA as a key player in the evolving quantum ecosystem, much like its role with AI accelerators.

title: AMD: Trading at a 20% Discount, This Misunderstood Stock Is a Buy | Morningstar UK
summary: Morningstar believes Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is undervalued, trading at a 20% discount to its fair value estimate despite a challenging 2024. The company is well-positioned in the lucrative AI chip market, second only to Nvidia, and its strong data center business is expected to drive significant growth. Morningstar maintains a "narrow economic moat" rating for AMD, citing its chip design expertise and its unique x86 instruction set architecture license.

title: Liberty All-Star Growth Fund Reports -3.94% December Drop, But 15.53% YTD Gain
summary: Liberty All-Star Growth Fund (ASG) reported a -3.94% NAV and -3.75% market price performance for December 2024, despite ending the year with strong year-to-date gains of 15.53% (NAV) and 16.53% (market price). The fund's portfolio, with 97.7% invested in equities, was concentrated in Information Technology (29.5%), Health Care (16.8%), and Industrials (16.8%), holding top positions in NVIDIA, Apple, and Amazon. The fund executed significant portfolio adjustments in December and traded at a -7.4% discount to its NAV.

title: Why Have Dividend Stock Strategies Been Underperforming?
summary: Dividend stock strategies significantly underperformed the broader market in 2024, with the Morningstar Dividend Composite Index rising 15.7% compared to the Morningstar US Market Index's 24.1% gain. This underperformance is primarily attributed to the low exposure to technology stocks within dividend strategies, as tech and communication services were the best-performing sectors. Additionally, many top market contributors like Nvidia, Apple, and Amazon have low or no dividend payouts, favoring share repurchases as a way to return cash to shareholders, which dividend indexes typically do not capture.

title: Liberty All-Star Equity Fund Reports December Decline Despite Strong 20.67% YTD Gains
summary: The Liberty All-Star Equity Fund (NYSE: USA) released its December 2024 monthly update, reporting a decline of -5.31% in NAV and -4.79% in market price for the month. Despite this, the fund maintained strong year-to-date returns of 14.06% (NAV) and 20.67% (market price). The fund, which categorizes as large-cap core, had net assets totaling $2,007.0 million, with 97.8% invested in equities, primarily in Information Technology, Financials, and Health Care.

summary: Commercial Vehicle Group (CVGI) has seen its stock drop significantly, prompting a look into its financial health. title: NVDX Is The Best Performing ETF of 2024!
summary: The T-Rex 2X Long NVIDIA Daily Target ETF (NVDX) was the top-performing ETF of 2024, achieving over a 383% total return. title: Tech Investing in 2025: Emerging Trends and Market Opportunities
summary: In 2025, technology continues to fuel innovation and economic expansion, with AI, semiconductors, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and renewable energy offering significant investment opportunities. A diversified investment strategy is crucial to navigate this dynamic environment, as the global economy and supportive policies are expected to provide strong tailwinds for the tech sector. The article highlights key areas like semiconductors, nuclear energy, and cloud computing, suggesting thematic ETFs (like SMH and NUCL) as practical solutions for broad exposure while mitigating risk.

title: Biden Administration Releases Executive Order on AI Infrastructure
summary: The Biden Administration issued an Executive Order on AI Infrastructure on January 14, 2025, aimed at advancing U.S. leadership in AI, preventing reliance on foreign infrastructure, and promoting clean energy for AI operations. The EO directs federal agencies to lease federal land for private-sector construction of "frontier AI infrastructure," including data centers and clean energy facilities, by specified timelines. It also outlines requirements for expedited permitting and upgrades to electricity grid infrastructure to support these AI developments.

title: MicroStrategy Sets Sights on Amazon and Alphabet’s Common Shares Dominance
summary: MicroStrategy is seeking shareholder approval to dramatically increase its authorized Class A common shares from 330 million to 10.3 billion, a move that would position it with more shares outstanding than many Nasdaq 100 tech giants. This expansion is designed to fuel its aggressive Bitcoin acquisition strategy, which has already seen its stock surge over 2,500% since 2020. Despite potential dilution concerns, investors appear to prioritize the company's Bitcoin-centric growth.

summary: T Stamp Inc. (NASDAQ:IDAI), specializing in AI-powered identity authentication, is featured among AI companies under a $2 billion market cap. The article discusses general market concerns about AI, including potential overreliance on key players and shifts in demand. It highlights IDAI's recent strategic partnership with Qenta Inc., involving a 10% stake in a new subsidiary and a $1 million licensing fee, projecting a significant net cash inflow for Trust Stamp.

summary: This article analyzes Blaize Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:BZAI) as an AI hardware company specializing in edge computing, assessing its position against other AI companies under a $2 billion market cap. summary: 2024 was a record-breaking year for ETFs, with investors pouring $1.1 trillion into these funds. The offering will feature two deployment options—vertically integrated and modular—and incorporate Cisco's security solutions from its Isovalent acquisition.

title: Dell’s new RTX Pro AI PC boasts an ‘unlimited turbo’ mode
summary: Dell has announced its new "Pro Max" lineup of workstation desktops and laptops, featuring Nvidia's RTX Pro Blackwell GPUs and an innovative "unlimited turbo" mode for sustained high performance in its Tower T2 desktop. This series targets AI developers and power users, offering advanced cooling, large displays, and significant memory and storage capacities, including options with tandem OLED screens and modular USB-C ports. The range will include both Intel Core Ultra Series 2 and AMD Threadripper CPUs, with some models shipping in March and others in July.

title: Unlocking the Future of Work with Unparalleled Performance for Advanced AI-Workflows
summary: HP announced new high-performance AI solutions and workstations, including collaborations with NVIDIA, to power advanced AI-workflows for engineers, data scientists, and AI developers. Key introductions include the HP ZGX Nano AI Station G1n, HP ZBook Fury G1i, and HP Z2 Tower G1i, all designed to enhance local AI capabilities, optimize performance, and improve security. The company also rolled out a simplified HP Z brand strategy with a new numbering structure for its ZBook portfolio to offer a more cohesive customer experience.

title: Lumentum collaborates with NVIDIA to enhance AI networking infrastructure
summary: Lumentum has partnered with NVIDIA to contribute its high-efficiency lasers to NVIDIA's Spectrum-X Photonics networking switches. This collaboration aims to reduce power consumption and accelerate deployment speeds in AI data centers. The initiative leverages Lumentum's expertise in indium phosphide laser solutions to improve resilience and energy efficiency, supporting larger AI infrastructures and facilitating a shift from copper to photonic interconnects.

title: NetApp Fuels Future of Agentic AI Reasoning Solutions with NVIDIA AI Data Platform
summary: NetApp is collaborating with NVIDIA to advance agentic AI reasoning solutions by integrating its ONTAP intelligent data infrastructure with the NVIDIA AI Data Platform. This partnership aims to help businesses leverage their data for AI inference by providing tools for global metadata management, integrated AI data pipelines, and disaggregated storage architectures. This will enable more efficient processing of unstructured data, improved data classification, and faster AI-driven decision-making, addressing the challenges of traditional computing architectures in the AI era.

title: NetApp Storage Now Validated for NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, and NVIDIA-Certified Systems
summary: NetApp has announced that its high-performance enterprise storage systems with ONTAP are now validated by NVIDIA for AI training and inferencing environments, including NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, and NVIDIA-Certified Storage. This collaboration aims to provide customers with intelligent data infrastructure for AI factories, leveraging NetApp's data management capabilities and NVIDIA's accelerated computing, networking, and software. The validation enables seamless, high-performance environments for AI model training and inferencing applications, with NetApp showcasing these updates at NVIDIA GTC 2025.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO Comes to Workstations and Servers for Designers, Developers, Data Scientists and Creatives to Build and Collaborate With Agentic AI
summary: NVIDIA has unveiled its new RTX PRO Blackwell series of GPUs for workstations and servers, designed to revolutionize workflows for professionals in AI, creative, engineering, and design fields. These GPUs offer groundbreaking performance for agentic AI, simulation, 3D design, and more, featuring advanced technologies like fourth-generation RT Cores, fifth-generation Tensor Cores with FP4 precision, and larger GDDR7 memory. The series includes desktop, laptop, and server editions, with availability starting in April and extending through the summer of 2025.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra DGX SuperPOD Delivers Out-of-the-Box AI Supercomputer for Enterprises to Build AI Factories
summary: NVIDIA has launched the Blackwell Ultra DGX SuperPOD, an advanced enterprise AI infrastructure designed to provide out-of-the-box AI supercomputing for generative and agentic AI workloads. Featuring new DGX GB300 and DGX B300 systems, these supercomputers offer enhanced AI reasoning and performance. Additionally, NVIDIA introduced Instant AI Factory, a managed service with Equinix, to provide preconfigured, Blackwell-ready data centers globally, addressing the increasing demand for scalable AI infrastructure.

title: NVIDIA and Telecom Industry Leaders to Develop AI-Native Wireless Networks for 6G
summary: NVIDIA has announced partnerships with T-Mobile, MITRE, Cisco, ODC, and Booz Allen Hamilton to develop AI-native wireless network hardware, software, and architecture for 6G. This collaboration aims to integrate AI from the ground up into future wireless networks to enhance efficiency, performance, and resource utilization, supporting billions of devices and creating new revenue streams. The initiative will leverage the NVIDIA AI Aerial platform and build upon existing AI-RAN research to accelerate innovation in 6G technology.

title: NVIDIA to Build Accelerated Quantum Computing Research Center
summary: NVIDIA announced the establishment of the Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC) in Boston, aimed at advancing quantum computing by integrating leading quantum hardware with AI supercomputers. The center will collaborate with innovators like Quantinuum, Quantum Machines, and QuEra Computing, as well as academic institutions such as Harvard Quantum Initiative and MIT's Engineering Quantum Systems, to solve critical challenges in quantum computing, including qubit noise and transforming experimental processors into practical devices. The NVAQC will leverage NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 systems and the CUDA-Q™ quantum development platform to facilitate complex simulations, precision control, and the development of hybrid quantum algorithms.

title: NVIDIA, Alphabet and Google Collaborate on the Future of Agentic and Physical AI
summary: NVIDIA, Alphabet, and Google are expanding their collaboration to advance AI, focusing on agentic AI, robotics, and broader accessibility of AI tools. Their joint efforts include optimizing open models like Gemma, developing advanced robotics capabilities through Intrinsic, and applying AI to drug discovery with Isomorphic Labs and grid optimization with X's Tapestry. Google Cloud will also adopt NVIDIA's latest Blackwell GPUs to power these research and production initiatives.

title: NVIDIA Launches Family of Open Reasoning AI Models for Developers and Enterprises to Build Agentic AI Platforms
summary: NVIDIA has introduced the Llama Nemotron family of open reasoning AI models, designed to help developers and enterprises build advanced AI agents. These models, enhanced through post-training, show significant improvements in accuracy and inference speed for complex reasoning tasks. Major companies like Microsoft, SAP, and ServiceNow are already integrating these models into their platforms to enhance AI-driven solutions and productivity across various industries.

title: NVIDIA Omniverse Physical AI Operating System Expands to More Industries and Partners
summary: NVIDIA announced the expansion of its Omniverse Physical AI Operating System into more industries and with additional partners. Leading industrial software and service providers like Ansys, Databricks, Dematic, SAP, and Siemens are integrating Omniverse to accelerate industrial digitalization through physical AI. New Omniverse Blueprints, including "Mega" for testing multi-robot fleets and an AI Blueprint for video search, are enabling robot-ready facilities and large-scale synthetic data generation for physical AI development.

title: Red Cat Stock Tumbles 7% Ahead of Q3 Earnings – Retail Awaits Contract Updates
summary: Red Cat Holdings (RCAT) shares dropped nearly 7% ahead of its Q3 earnings, with analysts expecting a net loss of $0.09 per share but a 28% year-over-year revenue increase. The decline follows leadership changes, including CEO Jeffrey Thompson serving as interim CFO, and a dip in retail sentiment due to a lack of new contract announcements. Despite this, analysts maintain optimistic long-term price targets, citing potential from new drone contracts and product launches even as the stock has lost over half its value in 2025.

title: Partner Interview: RADCOM
summary: Benny Eppstein, CEO of RADCOM, discusses AIOps, the integration of RADCOM's solutions with ServiceNow, and their utilization of the Nvidia BlueField-3 DPU. The interview highlights how RADCOM leverages this technology for advanced user plane data capture and analytics. This conversation took place at MWC Barcelona 2025.

title: Should You Buy Serve Robotics Stock After Its 65% Plunge? Nvidia's Recent Move Might Hold the Answer.
summary: Serve Robotics, which develops autonomous delivery robots powered by Nvidia's technology, saw its stock plunge 65% after Nvidia sold its entire stake. While Serve's revenue is rapidly growing due to an Uber Eats contract to deploy 2,000 new robots in 2025, the company also faces significant losses and a very high valuation compared to its revenue. Despite the potential for future growth in a large addressable market, the current valuation suggests the recent stock plunge may not yet represent a buying opportunity.

title: Yum Brands partners with Nvidia to accelerate AI technologies across its global system
summary: Yum Brands has partnered with Nvidia to advance AI technologies across its global restaurant system, leveraging Nvidia's applications to scale its Byte by Yum platform. The collaboration will initially focus on enhancing voice AI ordering in drive-thrus and call centers, implementing computer vision for operational efficiency, and using AI-generated analytics for restaurant intelligence. Pilots are already underway in select Taco Bell and Pizza Hut locations, with a broader rollout planned for 500 restaurants across all Yum Brands in the second quarter.

title: Taco Bell parent Yum Brands partners with Nvidia to speed up its use of AI
summary: Yum Brands, parent company of Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and KFC, is partnering with Nvidia to enhance artificial intelligence implementation across its restaurants. This collaboration aims to accelerate AI-driven order-taking, integrate Nvidia-powered computer vision, and improve restaurant performance assessments. The move reflects a broader trend among fast-food chains using AI to optimize operations, reduce labor costs, and stay competitive.

title: Cisco to Deliver Secure AI Infrastructure with NVIDIA
summary: Cisco and NVIDIA are collaborating to create the "Cisco Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA," an architecture designed to simplify and secure the deployment and management of AI infrastructure for enterprises. This initiative integrates networking and security solutions, including Cisco Hypershield and AI Defense, to protect AI workloads, models, and applications. The partnership aims to address complex security challenges in AI factories, offering flexible deployment options with validated reference architectures.

title: Ansys to Integrate NVIDIA Omniverse
summary: Ansys will integrate NVIDIA Omniverse into select products, starting with Fluent and AVxcelerate Sensors, to enhance data processing and visualization capabilities. This integration aims to streamline simulation processes, provide photorealistic models for intuitive engineering insights, and facilitate real-time collaboration. The partnership will impact various industries, including automotive, aerospace, electronics, and healthcare, by improving model interoperability, scalability, and modularity.

title: Supermicro Adds Portfolio for Next Wave of AI with NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra Solutions, Featuring NVIDIA HGX™ B300 NVL16 and GB300 NVL72
summary: Supermicro is expanding its AI portfolio with new systems and rack solutions powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra platform, including the NVIDIA HGX B300 NVL16 and GB300 NVL72. These solutions aim to deliver breakthrough performance for demanding AI workloads, leveraging enhanced HBM3e memory and 800 Gb/s networking. Supermicro highlights its advanced liquid-cooling technology for efficiency and reduced environmental impact, showcasing these innovations at the GTC 2025 Conference.

title: Storage vendors rally behind Nvidia at GTC 2025
summary: At GTC 2025, twelve major storage vendors, including Cloudian, Cohesity, Dell, HPE, Hitachi Vantara, NetApp, VAST Data, and WEKA, announced support for Nvidia's AI stack, integrating their products with Nvidia's Blackwell Ultra GPUs and AI Data Platform. These integrations focus on providing high-performance storage, data management, and AI infrastructure solutions to accelerate AI training and inferencing workloads for enterprise customers. The announcements feature new reference architectures, software enhancements for AI data processing, and optimized systems leveraging Nvidia's GPU, networking, and software technologies.

title: Storage vendors rally behind Nvidia at GTC 2025
summary: At Nvidia GTC 2025, twelve major storage vendors, including Dell, HPE, NetApp, and VAST Data, announced strategic collaborations and product integrations with Nvidia's GPU and AI Data Platform. These partnerships aim to optimize storage solutions for AI workloads, supporting Nvidia's Blackwell Ultra GPUs and AI software, and are designed to accelerate AI training, inferencing, and data management in anticipation of an "agentic AI boom." Key announcements include new reference architectures, enhanced data platforms, and specific validations for Nvidia's AI infrastructure, highlighting a concerted effort to integrate storage seamlessly within the AI ecosystem.

title: HEICO shareholders approve board, executive pay, and auditor
summary: HEICO Corporation held its Annual Meeting of Shareholders, where all ten director nominees were re-elected, executive compensation received advisory approval, and Deloitte & Touche LLP was ratified as the independent auditor. The company reported strong financial health with over $36 billion market cap and impressive revenue growth. These decisions are set to guide HEICO's strategic direction, building on its recent strong Q1 2025 results and analyst upgrades.

title: Supermicro Introduces a New Petascale All-Flash Storage Server Using NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip for High Performance Software-Defined AI Storage Workloads
summary: Supermicro has introduced a new petascale all-flash storage server designed for high-performance software-defined AI storage workloads, utilizing the NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip. This system combines Supermicro's petascale architecture with the energy-efficient NVIDIA Grace CPU, offering a high-density solution for AI/ML training, inferencing, analytics, and enterprise storage. The collaboration with NVIDIA and WEKA aims to provide power-efficient, high-performance storage systems for AI factories, demonstrating significant performance scaling and power efficiency.

title: GE HealthCare, Nvidia working on autonomous imaging
summary: GE HealthCare is expanding its AI partnership with Nvidia to include autonomous X-ray and ultrasound applications, leveraging Nvidia’s Isaac for Healthcare platform. This collaboration aims to address radiology staff shortages and enhance efficiency by automating repetitive tasks and streamlining workflows in medical imaging. The initial focus will be on developing autonomous X-ray systems and later extending to ultrasound to reduce sonographer workload and improve patient care.

title: Outlook 2025: GenAI to Push Semiconductor Industry Towards a New Growth Phase
summary: Generative AI is expected to be the main growth driver for the semiconductor industry in 2025 by increasing demand for advanced computational power. This will lead to new market opportunities in AI-enabled devices across various sectors and drive in-house chip design and specialized, energy-efficient AI hardware for edge deployments. The industry faces challenges in energy consumption and model compatibility, requiring collaboration and standardized frameworks.

title: Nvidia reveals plan to scale AI 'factories' with co-packaged optics
summary: Nvidia has announced its strategy to scale AI "factories" using silicon photonics and co-packaged optics (CPO) technology to enhance efficiency and reduce power consumption. Through its new "Spectrum-X" and "Quantum-X" network switch technologies, Nvidia plans to connect millions of GPUs using 1.6 Tb/s port switches with CPO, significantly decreasing power consumption compared to traditional methods. Key industry players like Lumentum, Coherent, and TSMC are collaborating on this initiative, with the first silicon photonics switch expected to ship in the latter half of this year.

title: Denny’s debuts Nvidia Breakfast Bytes
summary: Denny's has launched a new limited-time menu item called "Nvidia Breakfast Bytes" to honor Nvidia founder Jensen Huang, who reportedly conceived the idea for Nvidia at a Denny's diner booth. This launch coincides with Yum Brands Inc. also announcing a partnership with Nvidia to integrate AI technologies across its restaurants.

summary: Global Mofy AI Limited announced its invitation to NVIDIA GTC 2025, an influential AI conference, from March 17 to 21, 2025. This participation aims to strengthen Global Mofy's presence in the North American market and advance its AI-driven solutions for virtual content production.

title: INOD Unveils Nvidia-Powered AI Safety Platform: Buy or Hold the Stock?
summary: Innodata (INOD) has launched a new Generative AI Test & Evaluation Platform, powered by Nvidia's inferencing technology, to address AI risk mitigation. summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. has partnered with NVIDIA to advance scalable AI networking solutions, leveraging Lumentum’s high-power, high-efficiency indium phosphide lasers. summary: NVIDIA recognized 14 Americas partners with its 2025 NVIDIA Partner Network awards at the GTC 2025 conference for their leadership in advancing agentic and physical AI across various industries. These partners have been instrumental in helping customers integrate NVIDIA-accelerated AI technologies, including large language models and generative AI chatbots, to solve complex challenges and transform business operations.

title: 13 AI-Focused Storage Offerings On Display At Nvidia GTC 2025
summary: At Nvidia GTC 2025, numerous storage vendors showcased new offerings designed to support the growing demands of AI infrastructure. These solutions aim to provide the high capacity and performance necessary for AI training, inference, and data management, addressing bottlenecks and improving efficiency in AI workloads.

summary: SoundHound AI has expanded its collaboration with NVIDIA, integrating NVIDIA AI Enterprise to enhance its voice AI solutions. Lucid Motors is highlighted as the first customer benefiting from this combination, which is expected to deliver faster, more accurate, and scalable voice AI experiences.

title: Stereotaxis Highlighted by NVIDIA at GTC Artificial Intelligence Conference and Accepted into NVIDIA Connect Program
summary: Stereotaxis (NYSE: STXS), a leader in surgical robotics, was highlighted by NVIDIA at its GTC artificial intelligence conference and accepted into the NVIDIA Connect program. This recognition underscores Stereotaxis's efforts to integrate AI into its robotic systems for minimally invasive endovascular surgeries. The company plans to focus on digital solutions, including AI, robotic automation, and data integration, to enhance its robotic technologies and operating room environments.

title: Wipro announces AI services for governments and enterprises around the globe
summary: Wipro has launched new agentic AI services aimed at empowering governments and enterprises globally to develop and deploy AI capabilities tailored to their unique infrastructure, data, workforce, and business networks. These services, leveraging Wipro’s WeGA Studio and NVIDIA AI Enterprise software, focus on driving innovation, economic growth, and AI sovereignty by enabling applications across various public sectors, unlocking customized large language models for local languages, providing responsible AI accelerators, and ensuring privacy and security compliance. The initiative aims to address the rising demand for ethical AI practices and data sovereignty, particularly for governmental and organizational clients.

title: NVIDIA Teams Up with GE, Google, IBM, And CrowdStrike To Redefine AI And Quantum Technology
summary: NVIDIA is establishing the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC) in Boston and announced multiple collaborations to advance AI and quantum computing. Partnerships include Google for AI initiatives across various industries, GE HealthCare for autonomous medical imaging, IBM for enterprise AI capabilities, and CrowdStrike for AI-driven cybersecurity. Additionally, NVIDIA is working with General Motors on AI-powered vehicles and Yum! Brands to revolutionize AI in the restaurant industry.

title: Denny’s Debuts New NVIDIA® Breakfast Bytes
summary: Denny's has launched a new limited-edition menu item called NVIDIA® Breakfast Bytes, inspired by NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang's favorite way to eat breakfast. This special dish honors Huang's journey from a Denny's employee to a tech titan and was unveiled at NVIDIA's GTC Conference. The NVIDIA Breakfast Bytes are available online for carryout or delivery for a limited time, and for dine-in at participating San Jose locations.

title: Global Mofy invited to Attend NVIDIA GTC 2025, Engaging in AI, Smart City, Gaming, and 3D Modeling Discussions
summary: Global Mofy AI Limited announced its invitation to attend NVIDIA GTC 2025, an AI conference for developers, from March 17 to 21, 2025. title: Synopsys lays out strategy for AI 'agents' to design computer chips
summary: Synopsys introduced a new technology called AgentEngineer, which uses AI "agents" to automate parts of computer chip design. This move aims to help engineers manage the increasing complexity and speed required for designing new AI server systems, as current R&D capacity is struggling to keep up with demand. The company envisions these agents eventually coordinating the design of complex multi-chip systems.

summary: This article provides an analysis of the JPMorgan US Growth Active ETF Trust Units (JGRO) traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange. summary: Akamai Technologies and Vast Data are partnering to accelerate AI inferencing by combining Akamai's distributed platform with Vast Data's technology for data-intensive computing. This collaboration aims to deliver next-generation AI infrastructure, bringing hyperscale performance, security, and efficiency closer to the digital touchpoint, especially for distributed inference workloads. The partnership will enable organizations to integrate data with better local response times and localization, moving away from centralized inference processing.

title: Quest, Google team on gen AI; GE Healthcare plans autonomous imaging
summary: Medtech companies showcased their latest AI advancements at Nvidia’s GTC 2025 conference. Quest Diagnostics announced a partnership with Google Cloud to leverage generative AI for data streamlining and personalized customer experiences. GE Healthcare expanded its collaboration with Nvidia to develop autonomous X-ray and ultrasound systems aimed at alleviating staff shortages and improving imaging workflows.

title: GM, Nvidia to partner on AI tech for factories and next-gen vehicles
summary: General Motors and Nvidia are expanding their partnership to integrate AI-powered technology into GM's next-generation vehicles and across its production facilities. This collaboration will see GM using Nvidia's Drive AGX platform for advanced autonomous driving and in-cabin experiences, and Nvidia's Omniverse platform to create digital twins of factories for enhanced efficiency and virtual testing. The initiative aims to leverage AI to revolutionize vehicle technology and manufacturing processes, addressing the growing demand for software-defined vehicles and personalized customer experiences.

title: Jensen Huang Clarifies on His Explosive Comment on Quantum Computers at Nvidia GTC
summary: During Quantum Day at Nvidia GTC 2025, CEO Jensen Huang clarified his earlier statement that practical quantum computers were 15 to 30 years away, which had caused stock prices of quantum computing companies to fall. Huang announced Nvidia's investment in a new Boston-based research facility, the Nvidia Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC), to accelerate quantum computing innovations, focusing on integrating A.I. supercomputing with quantum systems and error correction. While acknowledging significant progress, panelists agreed that full-scale practicality for quantum computing is still under development, and Huang challenged the industry to prove its real-world value.

title: MSCI World ETFs too volatile for you? Three investment alternatives
summary: This article explores alternatives to MSCI World ETFs for investors concerned about their volatility or heavy US stock concentration. title: EPRI, NVIDIA and Collaborators Launch Open Power AI Consortium to Transform the Future of Energy
summary: EPRI, NVIDIA, and collaborators have launched the Open Power AI Consortium to revolutionize the energy sector through AI. This global initiative aims to develop open AI models using industry-specific data to enhance grid reliability, optimize asset performance, and improve energy management. The consortium will work on challenges like integrating distributed energy resources and managing increased grid loads, with the goal of creating a more resilient and affordable energy future.

title: Should You Buy Vertex Pharmaceuticals Stock At $510?
summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:VRTX) stock has seen a significant 27% surge year-to-date, contrasting sharply with the S&P 500's decline, driven by FDA approval of its new non-opioid pain reliever, Journavx. title: Micron forecasts upbeat quarterly revenue on strong AI memory chip demand
summary: Micron Technology projected third-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates, driven by robust demand for its high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips crucial for AI models. Micron also expects improved profitability in fiscal 2025 across both data center and consumer markets, despite potential uncertainties from new tariffs.

title: CoreWeave aims to raise up to $2.7 billion in IPO
summary: CoreWeave, a company specializing in providing Nvidia's AI processors, plans to raise up to $2.7 billion in its upcoming initial public offering. CoreWeave has experienced rapid growth, with a significant portion of its revenue coming from clients like Microsoft, which utilizes CoreWeave's services to meet OpenAI's demand.

title: Trump tally: J&J plans $55 billion investment to expand U.S. manufacturing
summary: Johnson & Johnson announced a $55 billion investment over the next four years to expand U.S. manufacturing, research, and technology. J&J's investment is part of a larger trend of major U.S. companies pledging significant spending to expand U.S. operations.

title: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup CoreWeave Sets IPO At $2.7B; OpenAI Will Get $350M In Stock
summary: Nvidia-backed AI startup CoreWeave is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) aiming to raise up to $2.7 billion, which would result in a $26 billion market valuation. title: Nvidia unveils next generation of DGX SuperPOD in partnership with Equinix
summary: Nvidia has unveiled its next generation of DGX SuperPOD, the DGX GB300 SuperPOD, designed to enhance AI inferencing with Grace Blackwell Architecture. This event marks another instance where Nvidia's announcements have impacted related tech stocks.

title: J.P. Morgan Upgrades Super Micro Computer on Improved Visibility and Blackwell Server Demand
summary: J.P. Morgan has upgraded Super Micro Computer (SMCI) from underweight to neutral, increasing its price target from $35 to $45. The firm projects Super Micro's fiscal year 2026 income to reach $39 billion, up from $34 billion, anticipating higher average selling prices and significant revenue growth despite a slight dip in gross margin forecasts.

title: Crash course: Meltdown in leveraged single-stock ETFs offers harsh lesson for investors
summary: Leveraged single-stock ETFs, which gained popularity during last year's equity rally, have experienced significant declines, raising concerns about investor understanding of their inherent risks. These products, designed for short-term traders to amplify daily price movements of individual stocks, have led to an estimated $1.7 billion in collective investor losses. Analysts warn that while these funds can offer dramatic gains in rising markets, they also carry severe risks in downturns, with many retail investors being drawn in by social media hype and unable to manage the volatility effectively.

title: SCHG Vs. VUG: Both Are An Equally Great Way To Capture The Tech Rebound
summary: The article discusses how SCHG and VUG are strong ETF options for gaining exposure to the tech sector, especially given the expected growth in AI spending. title: Chipmaker Micron's shares slump as tepid margin forecast eclipses AI prospects
summary: Micron's shares dropped 8% after the company issued a conservative gross margin forecast, overshadowing a strong revenue outlook driven by demand for AI-related semiconductors. The lower profitability is largely attributed to oversupply and weak pricing in consumer memory chips (NAND Flash), despite high demand for its high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips used in AI applications. While the company raised its full-year guidance, management expressed caution regarding macroeconomic uncertainties that might lead customers to phase or delay purchases. Despite potential headwinds, PTC's subscription model, AI-driven enhancements, and focus on cost control are expected to support future performance.

summary: AGM Group Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: AGMH) announced a 50-for-1 share consolidation, effective June 3, 2025, to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. title: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) Gains Boost As Bank Of America Raises Target On AI Deal Momentum
summary: Bank of America has reiterated its "Buy" rating for Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and raised its price target to $130 from $120. This boost comes from the potential upside in long-term AI opportunities, including multi-year AI infrastructure projects with Saudi Arabian AI startup HUMAIN, estimated at $3B-$5B annually. The bank believes "Sovereign AI" could mitigate power limitations for data centers in the U.S. and reduce the impact of export restrictions to China, positioning AMD as a strong player in the expanding global AI market.

title: How AGIX and KWEB Provide Access To The Distinct U.S. & China AI Ecosystems
summary: The article discusses how combining AGIX and KWEB ETFs offers a blended approach to investing in the global AI opportunity by accessing both the U.S. and China AI ecosystems. It highlights the distinct characteristics and developments within each region's AI landscape, from the U.S.'s rapid innovation spurred by ChatGPT to China's cost-effective, open-source models exemplified by DeepSeek. The piece concludes that a combined portfolio effectively harnesses the long-term growth potential of the AI sector by leveraging the complementary strengths of both countries.

title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: Bit Digital, Inc. announced its financial results for the First Quarter of 2025, reporting a total revenue of $25.1 million, a 17% decrease year-over-year, primarily due to a decline in digital asset mining revenue following the April 2024 halving. Cloud services revenue, however, saw an 84% increase, significantly offsetting the decrease. The company also highlighted strategic advancements in its infrastructure platform and diversification of revenue streams, including new cloud services agreements and the rebranding of its HPC business as WhiteFiber.

title: Supermicro's Revolutionary Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS) Simplify and Shorten Global-Scale Buildouts of AI/IT Liquid-Cooled Data Centers
summary: Supermicro introduces its Data Center Building Block Solutions (DCBBS) to simplify and accelerate the deployment of liquid-cooled AI/IT data centers globally. This solution is designed to overcome the complexities of outfitting AI factories by providing pre-validated scalable units, comprehensive services, and customized options. DCBBS aims to reduce costs, improve quality, and offer significant power and footprint savings, leading to a 20% lower Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

title: Qualcomm confirms it is re-entering the data center CPU market, starting with Saudi Arabia's AI cloud project
summary: Qualcomm has announced its re-entry into the data center CPU market, partnering with Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN AI for a state-backed AI cloud infrastructure project. This move follows Qualcomm's previous attempt in 2017 and aims to establish cutting-edge AI data centers in Saudi Arabia using Qualcomm's edge and data center solutions. The agreement also includes the establishment of a Qualcomm Design Center in Saudi Arabia, building on their acquisition of Nuvia and recent high-profile hires.

title: Broadcom vs. Marvell: Which Semiconductor Stock Has Greater Upside?
summary: This article compares Broadcom (AVGO) and Marvell Technology (MRVL), two key semiconductor providers in the AI data center market, to determine which stock offers greater potential upside. While both companies benefit from the growing semiconductor market, Broadcom is favored due to its expanding AI portfolio, strong partner base, and favorable Zacks Rank compared to Marvell's near-term challenges with excess chip inventories and export restrictions. The analysis highlights Broadcom's leadership in custom AI accelerators and its expected revenue growth in AI and semiconductor segments, positioning it as a better buy despite both being considered overvalued.

title: Breakthrough: Ekso Bionics Partners With NVIDIA to Create Revolutionary AI-Powered Rehabilitation Technology
summary: Ekso Bionics has been accepted into the NVIDIA Connect program, initiating a strategic move to develop the world's first foundation model for human motion in physical rehabilitation. Leveraging NVIDIA's resources, including specialized training and GPU platforms, Ekso Bionics aims to integrate new AI capabilities across its device portfolio. CEO Scott Davis highlights this collaboration as the beginning of their AI journey to enhance exoskeleton technology and improve patient outcomes through personalized rehabilitation.

title: TSS Stock Jumps On AI-fueled Q1 Results, Strong Guidance: Retail Exuberance Abounds
summary: TSS, Inc. (TSSI) shares surged after reporting significant increases in Q1 2025 profits and revenue, driven by strong growth in procurement and systems integration, including AI rack integration services. TSS also provided positive guidance for the remainder of the year and into 2026, expecting full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA to be at least 50% higher than 2024.

title: 3 Mid-Cap Stocks Turning Heads in AI, Automation, & Cybersecurity
summary: This article highlights three mid-cap technology stocks—Nebius Group (NBIS), UiPath (PATH), and Varonis Systems (VRNS)—that are gaining attention in the AI, automation, and cybersecurity sectors. This collaboration aims to diversify the global rare earth supply chain, leveraging Saudi Arabia's resources and MP Materials' expertise. The initiative is part of broader US investment in Saudi Arabia, with the goal of strengthening critical mineral supply chains amidst growing demand for advanced technologies.

title: Just Four Days Till Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) Will Be Trading Ex-Dividend
summary: Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) is set to trade ex-dividend in four days, with a dividend payment of US$0.455 per share scheduled for June 5th. The company paid a total of US$1.82 last year, resulting in a 3.0% trailing yield on its current stock price of US$61.21. Despite being unprofitable last year, Microchip Technology has shown improving income over the past five years and has consistently increased its dividend by approximately 9.8% annually over the last decade.

title: Clean energy stocks shine bright as improved trade outlook sparks rally
summary: Clean energy stocks, particularly solar names, experienced a significant rally following an improved U.S.-China trade outlook, which included tariff cuts and prompted economists to upgrade growth forecasts. title: NVIDIA RTX PRO Servers Speed Trillion-Dollar Enterprise IT Industry Transition to AI Factories
summary: NVIDIA announced its RTX PRO Servers and a new Enterprise AI Factory validated design to accelerate the trillion-dollar IT industry's transition to AI factories. These servers, built with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, offer universal acceleration for AI, design, engineering, and business applications. Companies like Cadence, Foxconn, and Lilly are already planning to adopt this infrastructure, with global system makers and consulting firms supporting the deployment.

title: Spotlight: Perfect Corp. Delivers Personalized Digital Beauty Experiences Using NVIDIA TensorRT and NVENC
summary: Perfect Corp. is leveraging NVIDIA TensorRT and NVENC to provide hyperpersonalized digital beauty experiences through augmented reality (AR) and AI. These technologies enable real-time skin analysis, AI-generated hairstyles, and accelerated video processing for features like AI Video Face Swap. This enhances realism, accuracy, and performance in their applications, making digital shopping more engaging and efficient.

title: Foxconn Builds AI Factory in Partnership With Taiwan and NVIDIA
summary: NVIDIA and Foxconn are partnering with the Taiwan government to build an AI factory supercomputer, featuring 10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, to boost AI computing for researchers, startups, and industries in Taiwan. This initiative, led by Foxconn's subsidiary Big Innovation Company, will also support TSMC's R&D and the Taiwan National Science and Technology Council's efforts to accelerate AI development across various sectors. The AI factory aims to enhance smart cities, electric vehicles, and manufacturing through advanced AI infrastructure and cloud services.

title: NVIDIA Expands Omniverse Blueprint for AI Factory Digital Twins With New Ecosystem Integrations, Development Tools
summary: NVIDIA has significantly expanded its Omniverse Blueprint for AI factory digital twins, now available as a preview, to empower engineering teams. This expansion includes new ecosystem integrations with industry leaders like Delta Electronics, Jacobs, and Siemens, joining existing partners to unify the design and simulation of AI factories. The blueprint enables the design, simulation, and optimization of entire AI factories in physically accurate virtual environments, using OpenUSD asset libraries and SimReady standardization to improve efficiency and reliability.

title: NVIDIA Unveils NVLink Fusion for Industry to Build Semi-Custom AI Infrastructure With NVIDIA Partner Ecosystem
summary: NVIDIA has introduced NVLink Fusion, a new silicon technology designed to empower industries to develop semi-custom AI infrastructure by leveraging NVIDIA’s NVLink ecosystem. Key partners like MediaTek, Marvell, Alchip Technologies, Astera Labs, Synopsys, and Cadence are adopting NVLink Fusion to create custom AI silicon for demanding model training and agentic AI inference workloads. Additionally, Fujitsu and Qualcomm Technologies plan to integrate their custom CPUs with NVIDIA GPUs using NVLink Fusion, scale-up, and Spectrum-X scale-out technologies to build high-performance AI factories.

title: NVIDIA Powers World’s Largest Quantum Research Supercomputer
summary: NVIDIA announced the opening of G-QuAT, which hosts ABCI-Q, the world's largest quantum research supercomputer, developed in collaboration with Japan’s National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST). This system integrates 2,020 NVIDIA H100 GPUs and NVIDIA CUDA-Q, enabling unprecedented scale in quantum-GPU computing. ABCI-Q aims to accelerate quantum computing research by combining AI supercomputing with various quantum processors, tackling complex challenges in healthcare, energy, and finance.

title: NVIDIA Launches AI-First DGX Personal Computing Systems With Global Computer Makers
summary: NVIDIA has announced new DGX Spark and DGX Station personal AI supercomputers, built by leading manufacturers like Acer, ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, Lenovo, and MSI. These systems are designed to offer unprecedented AI performance and efficiency for developers, researchers, and data scientists, addressing the growing demand for robust AI computing solutions that can handle agentic AI systems. Powered by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell platforms, they enable prototyping, fine-tuning, and inference of models from desktop to data center, with DGX Spark available in July and DGX Station later this year.

title: NVIDIA Powers Humanoid Robot Industry With Cloud-to-Robot Computing Platforms for Physical AI
summary: NVIDIA has announced significant advancements in cloud-to-robot computing platforms for physical AI, introducing NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.5, an updated foundation model for humanoid reasoning, and Isaac GR00T-Dreams, a blueprint for generating synthetic motion data. These innovations aim to accelerate humanoid robot development by enabling faster training and adaptation to new environments, with major robot manufacturers already adopting NVIDIA's Isaac platform technologies. The company emphasizes its role in providing comprehensive building blocks for the robotics development journey, from AI brains to simulation environments.

title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Partners With DataVolt to Build Saudi AI Campuses
summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) has partnered with Saudi Arabian startup DataVolt to develop hyperscale AI campuses in Saudi Arabia. This collaboration will utilize Supermicro's advanced GPU platforms, storage, and rack PnP systems, including liquid cooling solutions, to create green and efficient AI infrastructure. This initiative is part of a broader push to establish the Middle East as a global AI hub, following significant AI and data center agreements negotiated by the US with countries like the UAE.

title: The secretive US factory that lays bare the contradiction in Trump's America First plan
summary: A Taiwanese company, TSMC, is building an advanced semiconductor factory in Arizona, which will produce the world's most advanced chips in the US for the first time. This move, aiming to avoid tariffs, is seen by Trump as a success of his "America First" policy, yet the factory itself represents the globalized nature of modern technology, relying on components and expertise from across the world. The article highlights the geopolitical significance of this factory amidst US-China tensions and Taiwan's "Silicon Shield" strategy, while also pointing out the inherent contradiction in Trump's protectionist approach to an inherently global industry.

summary: Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to provide scale-up connectivity solutions for the new NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, integrating NVLink into its Intelligent Connectivity Platform.
